entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, VeloFit agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse. I got it about 12 days ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical problem. The device is just not working properly. I've tried everything, but it won't sync with my phone's VeloFit app.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the syncing. Can you tell me a bit more about what's happening? You believe the unit itself might be broken?
Yes, I think it's defective. It connected once on the first day, but now it won't hold a connection for more than a few seconds. I just want to return it and get my money back.

I understand your frustration completely. Since you received the VeloBand Pulse 12 days ago, you're just outside our specific 10-day return window for that model. However, because you're describing what sounds like a defective unit, our policy is to first get you to our Tech Support team. They can diagnose the issue remotely and, if they confirm a hardware fault, they can authorize an immediate replacement for you.

Hmm, a transfer to another department sounds like a hassle. I'm pretty sure it's broken. Instead of all that, how about we just call it an even exchange or you give me a partial credit for my trouble? I'm not trying to be difficult, but my time is valuable.

I appreciate your position, and I agree that your time is important. That's precisely why the transfer is the most direct path. Our Tech Support team is equipped to resolve this much faster than a standard return and re-order would be. They need to validate the 'won't sync' issue in our system to process a warranty claim. I can't issue credits or refunds on a potentially defective item until they've confirmed the fault.
So there's no way around talking to them? No discount code for a future purchase for the inconvenience?

Unfortunately, no. The first step must be the technical diagnosis. It's the official process to ensure we get you a fully functioning device as quickly as possible, which is our top priority. They are excellent and this is what they specialize in. Would you be willing for me to transfer you to them now?
Alright, that seems to be the only path forward. If they can confirm it's broken and get a new one sent out, I suppose that works. Yes, please make the transfer.
Excellent. I'm confident they'll get this sorted out for you. I'm connecting you now. Your reference number for this call is 774-0124. Please hold for one moment.
